acceptance_criteria.expectation: Missing required registry or omitted discovered fixed policy must reject before export. Explicit empty is allowed only with no discovered policies. Duplicate JSON keys, duplicate policy IDs/refs and duplicate or reversed pair edges must reject.

Policy pair must contain two distinct known train-study UIDs; raw report bytes and hashes bind current source and referenced blinded batch. Unknown/self UID, changed report, changed batch index or missing member rejects. Sources with merely equal declared hashes but different actual text reject.

Two distinct independently identified source-first assessments each contain exactly one matching record for BOTH edge endpoints. Copied identities, missing one endpoint, swapped source records, altered text/hash and wrong frozen-stage/exposure lineage reject. Preserve actual prior exposure instead of claiming first-ever blinding.

The accepted source-similarity proof must identify the same pair and exact two source-assessment artifacts, and reference their exact checksums. Unrelated otherwise valid proof, swapped pair, rehashed tampered links and changed evidence bytes reject. Timestamps do not alone prove source-first reasoning.

Accept the actual single redundant period with adjacent space between an existing sentence terminator and the next heading. Reject arbitrary inserted periods, decimal-point changes, word/negation changes, more than one independent punctuation edit and broad punctuation normalization. Preserve originals and existing normalized-report groups.

Synthetic chain A(similarity)B(exact-report)C(pixel)D(gold) must become one component; A/B/C quarantine and D remains official gold. Correspondence-excluded bridge remains in graph. No removal based on masks. Ungold chain remains in one active split. Permutation of row/edge order produces same component/splits.

Validated similarity edges and components are unchanged when synthetic gold values or reviewed states change; only ordinary split/quarantine consequences may differ with gold membership. Official gold values/masks and source clinical states/evidence remain untouched.

Final manifest/audit records registry hash, policy/assessor/proof/source hashes, explicit additional pair edges and group membership lineage. Missing or corrupt policy blocks before writing any release output. No patient/site or same-image inference from the edge.

scope: Read-only review design before root identifies stable implementation. No clinical annotation or gold values read; future adversarial integration data must be synthetic. No implementation acceptance claimed.
